item.text: {"signals":[],"reasoning":"I abstain from adding signals. The qualified mismatches concern observed recipe Y; they do not establish an omitted interaction predicting Z conditional on Y. For example, two implementations have Y approximately -0.409 and -0.381 but Z approximately -0.064 and 0.075, with substantial seed variation in Z. This motivates investigation without establishing a reusable implementation effect. Large negative Z under removal also accompanies large changes in Y, so it cannot establish an additional conditional removal penalty. Only three task profiles are available, making nonlinear combinations of their measurements vulnerable to acting as task proxies. The baseline already includes every pairwise interaction; no incremental conditional evaluation is supplied. The working null is that adding an interaction provides no reliable improvement in predicting Z conditional on Y. Future task-held-out evidence would falsify that null if a prespecified interaction consistently improves conditional Z prediction and unseen candidate decisions beyond the quadratic baseline, accounting for task-balanced uncertainty and the 0.01 response scale floor. At p=0.5, target improvement is Y+0.5*Z; positive Z alone does not imply target benefit."}
